branch_activations.carrier: Bākhiʿ carries exertion toward the last available strength or content.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Nafs, hadith, and asaf supply the finite resource, hoped-for emergence, and failed-growth pressure.
branch_activations.activation: The exertion carrier meets the cultivation and barrenness roles, producing a bounded depletion mechanism.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Trying to cultivate reception can work the speaker's own strength toward its limit.
branch_activations.boundary: The soil and animal specializations of the branch are not imported.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: şeyin kendisi ve bütün öz varlığı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin bütün gerçeği ve öz varlığıyla kendisini pekiştirerek gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: Nafs carries the whole self as the resource on which depletion is borne.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Bākhiʿ supplies the exertion that reaches the self itself.
branch_activations.activation: The whole-self carrier makes the cultivation effort return to the speaker's own substance rather than an external field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The self becomes the complete resource spent in trying to produce reception.
branch_activations.boundary: The self-emphasis is attributed and does not erase the ordinary accusative object.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yokken var olma, var etme veya gerçekleşme
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir iş ya da durum, daha önce yokken gerçekleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: Hadith carries the hoped-for emergence of a new state of reception.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The exertion carrier is directed toward the self and the discourse, supplying an attempted production of belief.
branch_activations.activation: The emergence facet meets the cultivation attempt, making the discourse the material through which a new state is sought.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The speaker's effort is heard as trying to bring trust into being.
branch_activations.boundary: Hadith remains discourse; no general creation claim is made.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanıklanan iki kullanımda ortak çizgi, beklenen büyümenin çok az gerçekleşmesi veya hiç gerçekleşmemesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Asaf carries the failed-growth and barrenness role in the attributed trace.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Bākhiʿ supplies cultivation effort and hadith supplies the state sought by that effort.
branch_activations.activation: The failed-growth facet meets the attempted cultivation, making nonreception a barren result of overwork.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The discourse does not grow into trust, and the cultivator's self is depleted by the attempt.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is applied as an attributed growth image; no literal soil or camel is claimed.

findings.title: An attributed report fails to become trusted transmission
findings.claim: An attributed reading makes nonbelief a failed handoff in which living speech does not become a trusted report carried by its hearers.
findings.mechanism: Hadith supplies renewed speech, athar supplies carried transmission, yuʾminu supplies inward assent, and bākhiʿ and asaf supply the costly effort and grief of the failed handoff.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive refusal as a broken transmission threshold rather than only a rejected message.
findings.containment: The ordinary report, belief, trace, grief, and self-destruction readings remain; the handoff is an attributed contextual synthesis, not a claim about an external transmission history.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT coordinates and roles are supplied, but the reconstructed reader identity is legacy_unbound and the relation remains attributed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Söz veya bilgi bir kişiden diğerine aktarılır.
branch_activations.carrier: Athar carries a report that could be transmitted onward.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Hadith supplies the live speech or report upstream of the handoff.
branch_activations.activation: The transmitted-report carrier meets the renewed speech, making the trace phrase the downstream side of reception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The report remains at a failed transmission threshold when assent does not occur.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent chain of transmission or writing is claimed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye işitme veya bildirim yoluyla ulaşan söz ve aktarılan içeriktir.
branch_activations.carrier: Hadith carries renewed speech reaching the hearers.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The negated belief verb and athar supply the failed receiving and downstream transmission roles.
branch_activations.activation: Speech meets the missing assent and carried report, forming the upstream side of the broken handoff.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Living discourse fails to become trusted testimony among its present hearers.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed relation does not redefine hadith or claim a separate historical chain.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
branch_activations.carrier: Yuʾminu carries the inward assent that would complete the handoff.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Hadith supplies the object and the conditional particle supplies the open reception frame.
branch_activations.activation: The acceptance carrier meets the living report and its failed condition, so nonbelief becomes the missing transfer step.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The report is heard but does not become trusted acceptance.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed role does not claim that assent occurs or alter the local negation.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: gücü tüketme ya da içindekini sonuna dek çıkarma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi ya da toprak, taşıdığı güç veya içerik son sınıra kadar kullanılarak zorlanır.
branch_activations.carrier: Bākhiʿ carries the effort spent trying to bridge the reception failure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The failed assent, renewed report, and grief supply the pressure that consumes the effort.
branch_activations.activation: Exertion meets the broken handoff, making the speaker's self-pressure the cost of trying to transmit.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The failed transfer becomes personally exhausting for the speaker.
branch_activations.boundary: No soil-extraction or general fatigue scene is asserted.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: güçlü üzüntü; yitirilene yönelik kullanımda hayıflanma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin yitirilmesine bağlanan kullanım, üzüntüye hayıflanma ve özlemli bir yakınma katar.
branch_activations.carrier: Asaf carries grief over the report that fails to become accepted.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The negated assent and renewed report supply the missed outcome that gives grief its loss pressure.
branch_activations.activation: Grief meets the failed handoff, making the missing reception personally costly.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The speaker grieves at a transmission threshold that the hearers do not cross.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed grief role remains within the local cause-or-state reading.
